# A 45% markup is not a 45% margin. It is not a 31% one either.

> Price a staffing placement properly: employer burden per hour, the real gross margin behind your markup, the break-even markup, and the markup a target margin needs. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
